scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c black,gray "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.db:dev: docker run -d --rm --name shelf-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpass -e POSTGRES_USER=shelf -e POSTGRES_DB=shelf -p 5433:5432 postgres:17-alpine
